source.citation: Unattributed drawing of a log building on a shore, with a woman in its doorway, a crowd of children on the bank, canoes afloat and drawn up, and a white lighthouse tower on a low point in the middle distance. Deposited by the repository owner on 2026-09-03 with the description "a great pic of the shore along there and the eliza chappel school at clark and lake".
what_it_does_not_supply: its own subject - whether the log building it draws is the Sauganash's annex or another schoolhouse is unsettled, and T-0649 established that the lighthouse cannot settle it
its own date, artist, title or repository
any coordinate, footprint outline or dimension
a station: the drawn figure scale falls off with depth 1.523x short of what a single viewpoint demands, so no drawn position on the sheet can be inverted to a viewpoint
a height for the tower: its foot is not drawn, and the admissible band is 4.65 to 23.41 m
corroboration of the Braunhold engraving: nothing has yet been read off it
what_it_supplies: nothing yet: no attribute of any committed record rests on this image
